title: Large-Scale Pretraining for Improving Deep Learning-Based Geometric Distortion Correction of Diffusion-Weighted Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2609.06437v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) is widely used in clinical settings but remains vulnerable to geometric distortion. Conventional correction methods often require additional acquisitions or vendor-specific solutions, limiting their feasibility in high-throughput, resource-constrained settings. This study investigates whether large-scale pretraining strategies can improve deep learning-based distortion correction for single-phase-encoding DWI. We formulate the task as image reconstruction, and compare a non-pretrained baseline against a self-supervised and a generative pretrained model, evaluated using both quantitative image-similarity metrics and qualitative expert assessment. The best-performing model was further tested for transferability on data collected in an LMIC setting with acquisition shift. translated_title: 大规模预训练用于改进基于深度学习的扩散加权成像几何畸变校正
translated_abstract: 扩散加权成像（DWI）在临床中被广泛应用，但仍然容易受到几何畸变的影响。传统的校正方法通常需要额外的采集或厂商特定的解决方案，限制了其在高通量、资源受限环境中的可行性。本研究探讨了大规模预训练策略是否能够改进基于深度学习的单相位编码DWI畸变校正。我们将该任务建模为图像重建问题，并将非预训练基线模型与自监督预训练模型和生成式预训练模型进行比较，同时采用定量图像相似度指标和定性专家评估进行评价。表现最佳的模型进一步在低中收入国家（LMIC）环境中采集的、存在采集偏移的数据上测试了其可迁移性。结果表明，预训练模型优于非预训练基线，其中cWDM在定量和定性评估中均取得了最佳效果。
tldr: 本研究证明大规模预训练策略（尤其是cWDM生成式预训练模型）能显著提升基于深度学习的DWI几何畸变校正性能，并在存在采集偏移的低中收入国家数据上展现出良好的可迁移性。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that large-scale pretraining, particularly the generative cWDM model, significantly improves deep learning-based geometric distortion correction for DWI, with strong transferability to data from LMIC settings with acquisition shift.
